quizzes.stem: Which exact value is the reciprocal of 2/3?
quizzes.explanation: 1 ÷ (2/3) = 3/2, and (2/3) × (3/2) = 1. A reciprocal undoes multiplication by the original nonzero value.

distractor_feedback.A: This is the additive opposite, not the reciprocal.
distractor_feedback.B: Multiplying 2/3 by itself does not give 1.
distractor_feedback.C: A positive original has a positive reciprocal.

quizzes.stem: Since 32 = 10 × 3.2, how does 1/32 relate to 1/3.2?

options.A: It is ten times as large.
options.C: It is one tenth as large.

quizzes.explanation: Multiplying the nonzero input by 10 divides its reciprocal by 10. Thus 1/32 = 0.3125 ÷ 10 = 0.03125.

distractor_feedback.A: This scales the reciprocal in the same direction as the input.
distractor_feedback.B: Changing the nonzero input changes its reciprocal.
distractor_feedback.D: The relationship is multiplicative, not additive.
